A0-01: Understanding Dutch Sounds and Spelling ​

CEFR Level: A0
Competency: Understanding Dutch Sounds and Spelling
Lesson ID: A0-01
Topics: Alphabet letters, Short vowels, Long vowels, Diphthongs, Consonants, Stress patterns
Total Words: 25
Status: Complete ✅

This lesson focuses on phonetic teaching examples rather than everyday vocabulary. All words serve as clear pronunciation models for Dutch sounds that differ from English.

Vocabulary by Phonetic Category ​

CategoryCountExamples
Alphabet Letters5a, bee, ee, ie, uu
Short Vowels5man, bed, vis, pot, bus
Long Vowels5maan, been, fiets, boom, muur
Diphthongs5huis, oud, auto, ei, ijs
Consonants4goed, hallo, rood, water
Stress Patterns1tafel

Master Vocabulary Database ​

All vocabulary is stored in shared/vocabulary/, split into four files by part of speech:

Location: shared/vocabulary/nouns.csv, verbs.csv, adjectives.csv, other.csv

Shared fields (all files):

  • Dutch
  • English
  • Pronunciation
  • CEFR Level
  • Lesson Introduced
  • Frequency Rank
  • Topic
  • Example Sentence
  • Example Translation
  • Notes

Nouns.csv adds: Article (de/het), Plural, Diminutive Verbs.csv adds: Verb Type, Present tense (ik / jij-u-hij-zij-het / wij-jullie-zij), Simple Past (singular/plural), Auxiliary, Past Participle Adjectives.csv adds: Comparative, Superlative, Inflected Form Other.csv adds: Part of Speech (adverb, preposition, conjunction, pronoun, article, determiner, interjection, numeral, phrase)

See docs/VOCABULARY_STANDARD.md for the full field-by-field rules.

Current Status: Only A0-01 populated (~25 words); the rest is to be populated in Phase 2.

Generated Exports ​

From the four vocabulary files, we generate:

By Level ​

  • shared/csv/A0.csv -- All A0 vocabulary
  • shared/csv/A1.csv -- All A1 vocabulary
  • shared/csv/A2.csv -- All A2 vocabulary
  • shared/csv/B1.csv -- All B1 vocabulary

By Lesson ​

  • shared/csv/lessons/A0-01.csv -- Vocabulary for A0-01
  • shared/csv/lessons/A0-02.csv -- Vocabulary for A0-02
  • (One for each lesson)

By Topic ​

  • shared/csv/topics/Family.csv -- All family vocabulary
  • shared/csv/topics/Food.csv -- All food vocabulary
  • (One for each topic)

Anki Decks ​

  • shared/anki/A0.apkg -- Anki deck for A0
  • shared/anki/Family.apkg -- Anki deck for family vocabulary
  • (Additional decks as needed)

High-Frequency Words Strategy ​

Vocabulary is selected based on:

  1. Frequency -- Most common words first
  2. Usefulness -- Essential for communication
  3. Context -- Grouped by topic/situation
  4. Difficulty -- Easier pronunciation/spelling first

The "Frequency Rank" in the master database reflects this, with lower numbers being more frequent.

Quality Rules ​

Every vocabulary entry must:

  • [ ] Exist in the correct shared/vocabulary/*.csv file (nouns/verbs/adjectives/other)
  • [ ] Have pronunciation guidance
  • [ ] Have an example sentence
  • [ ] Be appropriate for its CEFR level
  • [ ] Not be a duplicate
  • [ ] Have all required fields
  • [ ] Use only known grammar in the example
